name: The Foxhole Market (Rotating Shelf Bazaar)
description: M88's most notorious ghost market, the Foxhole operates on a weekly rotation through seventeen confirmed Shelf locations — flooded parking structures, decommissioned water treatment annexes, the gutted interior of the collapsed Meridian Elevated Rail car depot on South Kedzie — announced exclusively through a physical pamphlet system called the Foxhole Flier, hand-distributed by a network of child couriers known as the Runners-Under. Unlike the Null Markets' digital anonymity, the Foxhole's paper-only system is deliberately archaic, making it nearly impossible for BCI-linked surveillance to anticipate locations. The market specializes in pre-corp-era artifacts, unlicensed geneware modifications, and synthetics operating without registered identity papers.
cultural_impact: The Foxhole's paper flier system has inspired a broader Shelf revival of analog communication — hand-lettered notices, physical message boards, and courier networks — as communities recognize the surveillance-evasion value of going fully offline.
locations: South Kedzie Rail Depot ruins (Shelf Sector 9)
Flooded Level B parking structure, former Lakeside Mall
story_hooks: A Foxhole Flier turns up somewhere it absolutely should not be — inside a sealed Tier 5 Spire residential unit — and the Runners-Under insist none of their couriers have ever been above Tier 2.

A synthetic without papers has been using the Foxhole's identity document trade for years but now wants something the market can't provide: legal recognition, and they'll pay anything to anyone who can help.

The Foxhole's next rotation lands in a location that a rival crew has already claimed for a completely different operation, and both sides want a neutral fixer to resolve the conflict before corp-sec notices the resulting chaos.
